text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I did everything I could to prepare for today… and I trained so hard… but it still wasn't enough…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, Trainer… You helped me so much, and yet I…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Maybe winning is too far out of reach for someone as mediocre as me…
choice_data_list: Do you want to give up, then?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I knew from the beginning that making my dream come true wasn't going to be easy!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Sorry for being so whiny. I'm fine now.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I know I keep losing, but I'm going to do my absolute best to change that, so please stay with me and keep guiding me onward!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: N-no! Absolutely not! I don't want to give up!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I still have a goal to achieve, so no matter how miserable I feel, I won't stop running!
choice_data_list: Your strong willpower is what makes you special.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'm going to work even harder than before. I'll do my best to improve my training plans as well.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I won't give up, so please stay with me and guide me onward!
